symbols.reasoning: Returns before drawing for dimensions <=1; otherwise assigns common brush, scans min/max, and clears geometry/shows dash for absent, one-point or constant series. Nonflat series maps points with 3px padding, builds line/area, places marker at last point. Linear scans plus geometry allocations O(n); long max-min subtraction occurs before double cast and can overflow at extreme long inputs. Width between1 and6 yields negative usable span. Domain monetary bounds and card minimum dimensions may mitigate these theoretical extremes.
